name: Platform Gateway Response
description: Platform gateway response (without registration token). Used for list and get.

vhost.description: Gateway URL (e.g. https://host or https://host:9443). Same name as platform API; type is URL.

isActive.description: Indicates if the gateway is currently connected to the control plane via WebSocket

permissionType.description:
Permission type for gateway visibility:
- PUBLIC: Gateway is visible to all users
- ALLOW: Gateway is visible only to specified roles
- DENY: Gateway is hidden from specified roles

roles.description: List of roles for ALLOW/DENY permission types
